policy: Candidate routes are research-stage exact legal scopes. They do not become publishable pathways until they receive canonical pathway ids, complete material evidence, and pass the normal promotion gate.

candidates.name: Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189) — Points-tested stream
candidates.scopeNote: Exact subclass 189 scope. Do not promote the AU-skilled umbrella or infer subclass 190/491 eligibility. The current financial record is an explicit research-gap finding, not a promotion proof.

candidates.name: Skilled Migrant Category — Skilled Work Experience pathway
candidates.scopeNote: Exact child route. Authoritative eligibility, direct-relevance, occupation-exception and wage-regression evidence is attached and machine-guarded; final promotion-gate testing remains open.

candidates.name: Skilled Migrant Category — Trades and Technician pathway
candidates.scopeNote: Exact child route. Authoritative occupation/qualification evidence is attached and machine-guarded; final promotion validation remains open.

candidates.name: Red-White-Red Card — Other Key Workers
candidates.scopeNote: Exact sub-route candidate. Official application-document and points-validation matrices are now attached; final promotion validation remains open.

candidates.name: 2026 non-seasonal subordinate work — Flussi route
candidates.scopeNote: Temporal 2026 quota/process candidate. Employer nulla-osta, sector/country quota, compensation/documentary and applicant evidence matrices are now attached; final route promotion still requires deterministic validation and current quota-state verification.

candidates.name: Skilled Migrant Category — Points-based pathway
candidates.scopeNote: Exact child-route candidate. Current official evidence covers point-category composition, registration and qualification/IQA exceptions. Promotion remains blocked until deterministic validation and promotion-gate tests pass.
